blocks.text: Rifts open at random on the district plazas of the city, every 45-80 s (faster with more awakened), up to 6 at once (3 per district). Each leads to a procedural dungeon of its rank: combat rooms, an event room, a sanctuary, side rooms and the guardian's arena. Clearing it closes the rift; left alone until its timer runs out, it may break.

Rifts open at random on the plazas of the four districts of the city . Walk in: combat rooms, an event room, a sanctuary, side rooms, then the guardian's arena. Beat the guardian to close the rift and collect your spoils. A rift left alone until its timer ends may break: monsters then pour into the district in waves.
